title: Texal Options
description: How Texal draws a table's preview, the list header and the flyer.

options.name: Play the playfield video
options.description: Play the table's playfield video in the preview when it has one. Without a video, or with this off, the preview is the playfield picture.

options.name: Play the backglass video in the list header
options.description: Play the table's backglass video above the list when it has one. Without a video, or with this off, the header shows the backglass picture.

options.name: Show the flyer
options.description: Show the table's flyer beside the preview, and a third panel with your own stats for the table: rating, plays, minutes and last played. A table with no flyer shows the preview alone.
